headline: Superliner SS United States Casts Off On Historic Maiden Atlantic Crossing
dispatch: The SS United States slipped her moorings at New York Harbor this morning, bound for Southampton on her maiden voyage. The vessel, the largest ocean liner ever built in America, carries over 1,800 passengers and crew. Naval architects have kept her top speed a closely guarded secret, but shipyard workers who fitted her engines say she is unlike anything that has crossed the Atlantic before.
answer: SS United States departs New York on maiden voyage, 1952
